title: HKU Graduation Bonanza
excerpt: Graduation work by more than 60 HKU students projected across Utrecht, after covid cancelled their exhibition.
description:
Covid restrictions meant the HKU in Utrecht could not hold a physical graduation exhibition, so we proposed projecting the work through the city instead. What started as a gesture towards the media students was picked up by every faculty, and more than 60 students submitted work. We took it on a projection tour of the public space.
> A graduation show is a threshold, and that year it had nowhere to happen. Putting the work on the walls of the city gave it an audience that had not come to see art, which is a harder and better audience to have.
credits: A LiGHT-UP Collective project with the HKU, University of the Arts Utrecht. Graduation work by more than 60 HKU students, projected in the public space of Utrecht, 2020.
